notes.title: Update 0.6 is out!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that we have released update 0.6. Here's what's changed in the game:

Added a construction grid showing the width of the playing field. We noticed that some players may not realize that they are not using all the cells available for construction. Adding a visual grid should solve this problem.

Added a new, medium game speed setting.

When trying to unlock a locked level, an info window about which level must be completed to unlock it is now displayed.

Now, if you don't have enough money, the prices of rooms on the construction panel are displayed in red.

Adjusted some backgrounds.

Fixed bugs that occurred when deleting full parking lots and rooms.

Slightly reworked the tutorial steps in accordance with player requests. The start of the game is now a little faster, with fewer guests before the first wave.

Fixed minor localization bugs.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/12857aa1f92f085eed0d82f527322bd9403d9c93.jpg"]

Meanwhile, we continue to work on a major release update that will add tourist trips from the hotel and two new levels in Europe.

Thank you for playing Check Inn!



As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish

notes.title: Big update 0.5 - new luxury hotel and level in Los Angeles!
notes.content:
Today's update adds a five-star hotel to the game. We tried to come up with some interesting shapes for the rooms of this hotel, so sometimes you'll have to think hard about how to place them. We hope you will like the luxurious look of the hotel too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/ead4827e5595be70a84faa0294568af49786bcbf.jpg
At the same time we have added a new level in Los Angeles, where you will have to build this new luxury hotel.

In addition to that:
- Fixed bugs in the French and German translations
- Fixed bugs that occurred in some cases when removing the elevator shaft (such as the porter freezing)
- Fixed a bug that occurred when deleting a room of the guest who is in the sauna at that moment

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/8aa2e68c34d6fa8cf8e7b49646e7cbdba2f5ca1a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/27b3345c9a33ff933cc18eb5998b17f65b980f9d.jpg
Thank you for playing Check Inn!

As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

notes.title: Update 0.4 - Exterminator Logic Overhaul
notes.content:
The main new feature of today's update is the new logic of exterminators' workflow. Earlier their work was almost similar to that of maids. We tried to introduce something new. Now an exterminator needs a special chemical to clean the room from insects. It is made in the exterminator's room by the exterminator themselves. Thus, the exterminator now performs two actions: in their spare time they produce the product, and then they clean the rooms with it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/eafb07734b4aed0d88c07e55310261d24c552803.jpg
Also, we've made the following changes:
- Now if you close the game on the game over screen, it will start from the same screen the next time you start the game
- Added a parking icon to the Cleveland waves timeline
- Fixed a bug where the construction sound could be unpaused
- Fixed words in different languages not being aligned properly on some interface buttons
- Fixed main menu appearance on “narrow” resolutions
- Now any reception appears with a facade first. The facade is removed after the direction for the elevator shaft is selected
- Removed old UI on the edges of the free game timeline

We are planning to release another big update that will add a five-star hotel to the game along with a new level very soon. Testing is already underway, so you won't have to wait long.

Thank you for playing Check Inn!

As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

notes.title: Update 0.3.1 - continuing to improve the quality of the game!
notes.content:
Today's update is dedicated to fixing recently found bugs.

List of changes:
- On the level in New York, returned the guest list of wishes on the wave start screen
- Internet cafe is now displayed on the wave list screen in Miami
- Fixed a bug where parking could not be built in the parking mechanism tutorial on low screen resolutions
- Fixed a bug where the next wave would not start if you ended the previous wave with the reception demolished
- Fixed the size of some localization texts on interface buttons
- Fixed a bug where guests always chose the nearest sauna out of two. Now, if the nearest sauna has too big of a queue, guests head to the farther one
- Fixed a bug where the background of a previous free game session could transfer over to the next one even when a new background was chosen in rare occasions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/d2d6cc5c5b06aea69469e356703f6e1477c1e119.jpg

Thank you for playing Check Inn!

As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

notes.title: Update 0.3 - New main menu and interface!
Update 0.2 - new rooms, underground parking lots, internet cafes and more
notes.content:
We are glad to present to you update 0.2, which took us a little over a month to prepare.
One more room for each hotel has been added to the game. We tried to make a variety of shapes to add more depth to the building process. That is, each hotel now has 6 living room types.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/d1d146387fc1801ac62b89d16ccf00e3961fcc5b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/024a05370fe583e9a58707ad66fb5c21b7a6dd61.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/4bd4faf55ebff62677bf8d7945604cc39164f425.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/31ee50be8c06cbe87b1b8574078793b35db05de6.png
Some guests will now demand a parking space for their car. To satisfy their desire, you can build an underground parking lot. One cell of underground parking includes three parking spaces. Guests leave their car in the parking space and wait for the elevator on the underground floors. A total of three underground floors are available for construction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/ff29f90af91b4f082e594b4541125c63c61f7e61.png
The Internet Cafe is a new service room. Guests who want to use a computer and access the internet can come here. Internet cafe can be upgraded by adding new places with computers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/b98326d8ce017a34a2f279ee758f1d94a9ad0d80.png
Due to these changes, we have redesigned all the levels. Therefore, you can play again from the beginning. Or replay the levels that you liked the most. You will definitely find something new on them. The changes have also affected the balance. Among other things, we tried to reduce the cost of managers so that starting from the level in New York it would be convenient for players to hire them and not to settle all the guests manually by dragging and dropping them into the rooms. Exterminators, who are hated by some, were also rebalanced (although we have an idea about them - in one of the next updates we will change the logic of their work - it will be more interesting!).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/0697a50467015e359749d77abdc00ab189e931ce.png
Building a hotel in the Free mode is now possible up to the hundredth floor! Due to this, we had to make adjustments to the balance, as well as to the background. What can you expect at such a height? Try to build a tall hotel and find out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/b0b81eebca3a2f9a2cb4688ecc5ed76b38b847c1.png
We have added Steam collectibles!
These include badges, 10 Trading cards, 5 Emoticons and 3 profile backgrounds.

In addition to that, there are a lot of small changes to the game:
- Added buttons to teleport the camera to the very bottom and the very top of the hotel. They appear on the left side of the screen when the hotel is at least 10 floors tall.
- Added new tutorial steps for presenting new features (such as building underground parking lots).
- Now if you delete a room during construction, the full cost of the room is returned.
- Fixed a bug where the room insulation window would open too high, off the screen.
- Fixed elevator checkboxes working in such a way that a checkbox is now always checked in one of the fields and you cannot uncheck it, leaving all fields empty.
- Fixed a bug when upon changing screen resolution, all guests fit on the waiting panel, but the scroll arrow still remained in place.
- Increased the maximum possible number of porters to 12.
- Fixed a bug in Montreal that occurred if you reached the second wave without buying service rooms and waited for the message that they should be bought, and then restarted the game so that the wave start window would appear afterwards.
- Other minor fixes.

Since the changes are significant, we had to remove progress within levels. However, global progress (information about which levels have been completed) will remain untouched. We hope you understand that this is a forced measure due to the redesign of all levels.

We wish you a pleasant game!

As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

notes.title: Preparing the next big update
notes.content:
Right now we are busy preparing the next big updates for the game. Let us tell you more about what to expect in the game in the next month.

We have decided to expand the construction area horizontally by four cells and add two new rooms for each of the hotels.

A new room will be added - an internet cafe. You will be able to upgrade it by adding new spaces with computers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/b4c0c77077bbd64da3049ae1f869f9a915495ba1.png
Some guests will require a parking space for their car. Underground parking lots will serve for this purpose. The hotel can now be expanded three floors down, but only parking spaces can be built underground. The load on the elevators will increase, because now they will have to deliver guests not only from the reception, but also from the parking lots.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/d99b11edb2ebbeacd94676cbe3cdf92ad91171ae.png
We are also expanding the construction of the hotel all the way up to the 100th floor in Free Game. We will try to make sure that the background is also not monotonous. At high altitude you will meet some interesting surprises :) We plan to rename this mode to “Quick Play” and also add a “Sandbox” mode soon. But more on that later.

In the meantime, our artist is working on redrawing the interface elements. It will become more convenient and more pleasant to the eye. Moreover, the changes will affect not only the existing elements, but also a new layout of the main menu will be added. You can take a look at our preliminary progress on the screenshots. Please, let us know your opinion - it is very important for us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/f34521df42627d7b99f753195fc9de602e82a3ec.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/9fb3eb706b4e2999ca97d599df4c1ae5e5b199ae.png
When can we expect all this? We are not ready to give an exact date of the update release (it is also possible that the interface redesign will be presented in a separate standalone update), but definitely in the next month. We will try to please you as soon as possible!

Thank you again for sharing your impressions of the game with us and other players, as well as leaving your suggestions. As always, we read all messages and take them into account in our work.

notes.title: Update 0.1.3 has been released!
notes.content:
In this update we have prepared both new game features and bugfixes.

Major changes:
- Added active pause mode. Now you can pause the game and during this time perform necessary actions - build new rooms, improve service rooms, check in guests and so on.
- Added the ability to choose the specialization of elevators. Now each elevator can be general (by default), for staff only or for guests only
- Added the ability to hire managers in Free Play

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/ae24b9f11128155e2707fec51e1ba2717544f7ce.jpg
Other changes:
- Added an option to stop clouds in Settings
- Added an option to change the temperature scale
- Global map is now zoomed out a bit more so that the maximum number of cities fit on the screen
- Improved overall game performance
- Changed some interface elements
- Fixed some localization bugs
- Fixed an issue where if there were two laundry rooms on neighboring floors, porters would only deliver laundry to one of them
- Fixed a bug that caused the exterminator's room to render on top of the wave indicator
- Fixed a bug where a porter would be removed immediately after pressing the cross button, rather than after agreeing to a prompt
- Fixed a bug with the sound of defrosting rooms
- Fixed a bug with restarting a Free Mode session where the game would rarely crash
- Blizzard volume is now linked to the SFX volume setting
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to start Free Mode session without selecting a difficulty
- Fixed a bug where the game speed would not slow down during the countdown that shows before a guest is missed

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/62526c12c4c71a40f329336716841054e6fce710.jpg
We are already preparing the next updates. They will include underground parking lots and a new service room - Internet Cafe.

We are also considering adding a Sandbox mode, where you can customize the game for yourself - choose parameters, for example, remove patience timers for guests, set the number of waves and their composition, and so on. What do you think about this idea? What game parameters in the settings of this mode would you like to see?

Today we released a small update with fixes for the bugs we found:

We are working on the next update, in which some of your suggestions will be implemented. We can already confirm the following features: active pause, different types of elevators (for staff/guests/all at once), manager in Free Mode and others.

If you like our game, please tell your friends and acquaintances about it. The more players, the more interesting ideas we can implement. Also, please share with us in the comments, where did you find out about our game? Where do you usually find information about new games? Thanks!

As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

notes.title: Development news: guest reviews, free mode, a separate page for the demo version
notes.content:
Today we will share information about what we are currently working on.

But first, let us tell you about the new feature in Steam for creating separate pages for demo versions of games. They look almost the same as the pages of standalone games. We decided to give it a try, and now the Check Inn demo version has its own page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963670/Check_Inn_Demo/

An important feature of the demo versions presented on a separate page is the ability to write reviews. Therefore, if you have already tried the demo - please leave a review there. And if you haven't tried it yet - it's the perfect time to catch up!

Guest reviews of their hotel stay
We decided to add guest reviews. When a guest checks out of the hotel, they leave a review of the hotel, giving it a rating on a five-point scale. Their rating is taken into account in the overall rating of the hotel, which can be seen at any time. When calculating the rating, various parameters are taken into account: the speed of their check-in, how quickly they got to the room by elevator, the speed of service (such as sauna, food delivery and laundry), the temperature in the room during their stay (on levels with variable temperature). It will be possible to open a separate window and read text reviews, which in some cases will help you understand what you need to pay attention to when developing the hotel. At the end of the level, this final rating will be used in the leaderboard as the player's main competitive indicator, that is, it will serve as a multiplier to all the other parameters when counting up your total score.

Free mode
We are working on a special mode that will be perfect for players who like long gaming sessions. Here you will be able to choose the difficulty level, hotel star rating and background that suits you. However, hotels and backgrounds in free mode are unlocked by completing regular levels. You will be able to compete with other players for a place in the leaderboard. Moreover, the higher the difficulty level, the more opportunities you have to score more points.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/f7d462db03b49f2aee9a355b03904cb9e5cd5533.png

As you can see, we are continuing development at the same active pace. There is not much time left before the game is released in early access. And we will announce the exact release date of the game soon in a separate post. So, stay tuned!

notes.title: Demo update - we added service rooms!
notes.content:
The update is really important, so those who have already completed the demo are invited to play again. The gameplay really feels different now.

The most important thing is that we have added service rooms. That is, any guest who stays at the hotel for more than 3 nights may want:

 Food delivery from the kitchen to their room. Accordingly, the hotel must have at least one kitchen.
 Washing their dirty clothes. In this case, the guest leaves a basket with dirty clothes in the hallway, and the porter must take it to the laundry. There, the clothes are loaded into the washing machine (or machines). When the washing is finished, the porter takes the clean clothes back to the room.
 Take a steam bath in the sauna. The guest themselves goes by elevator to the floor where the sauna is located and occupies one of the rooms in it for a while. One room - one guest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/bb3c1542d71fc5f5d9827cf1ae33f2f1fe56485c.jpg
As you can see, a new important role has been added to the hotel - the porter. They can carry two items on their carts: food, dirty or clean laundry. If you see that one porter can no longer cope with the delivery, you can hire a few more.

Each of the service rooms can be upgraded. For example, in the kitchen, you can increase the speed of cooking, their quality, capacity (affects the number of ready meals that the porter can pick up at any time).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/c8d2fc12d54a6859afad9caa3c352c75204360a3.jpg
We also added the ability to zoom the camera in and out. This can be done using the mouse wheel. And you can now move the camera to the side using the arrows on the keyboard or the WASD keys.
Due to the mentioned changes, the entire demo version level has undergone a serious rebalance. Please let us know about your opinion on this update. Did you like the fact that the gameplay in the game is becoming more profound? As always, we read all messages and try to respond to them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/585508a133fab587e658bd07b337c63ff2dda892.jpg
We remind you that the best way not to miss the release of the game is to add it to your Wishlist. This way, you will receive a message by email at the time of release.
